The situation

A patient calls to request a routine dental check-up next week.

01 · ON THE CALL

A conversation that helps.

See how your AI practice receptionist handles this enquiry.

Call recording coming laterFor now, follow the written example below.
WRITTEN EXAMPLE · FICTIONAL CALLER AND DETAILS
  1. AI practice receptionist

    Thanks for calling the practice. I’m the AI receptionist. How can I help?

  2. Caller

    I’d like to book a routine dental check-up.

  3. AI practice receptionist

    Of course. Are you an existing patient, and what name should I put on the request?

  4. Caller

    Yes, I’m Alex Taylor. A morning next week would suit me.

  5. AI practice receptionist

    Thank you, Alex. May reception text you on this number with an available appointment?

  6. Caller

    Yes, please.

  7. AI practice receptionist

    I’ll pass on your request for a routine check-up next week in the morning. Reception will confirm the appointment with you.

When your team takes over

Clinical questions and urgent concerns are passed to staff using your practice’s agreed process. The AI receptionist handles administration and does not give clinical advice.

This is an illustrative conversation and workflow, not a live call or a customer result. The actions available depend on your connected tools, information and agreed rules. We test the full process with you before launch.
